name: SharePresenterView

module.name: SharePresenterView
module.description: Previews the local participant's shared screen, scaled to fit its container while keeping the shared content's aspect ratio. Displays an empty area when the local participant is not sharing.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS class for the root container.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the root container. Set width and height here or size the parent container.

props.name: hidden
props.description: Hides the preview while keeping it mounted.

notes: The view stays empty until the session is connected.
The preview has no name label.
